description: This file defines the LoanTermVariations entity class which models variations in loan terms within the Fineract loan management system. It includes JPA annotations for persistence and methods for accessing and modifying its properties, representing different configurations of loan term adjustments.

classes.name: LoanTermVariations
classes.description: Entity class representing variations in loan terms, including fields for variation type, applicable date, value, related loan, and status, with JPA annotations and serialization methods.

methods.name: LoanTermVariations
methods.description: Constructors for creating LoanTermVariations instances with various levels of detail.

methods.name: toData
methods.description: Converts the entity instance into a data transfer object (LoanTermVariationsData).

methods.name: getTermType
methods.description: Returns the term variation type as an enum.

methods.name: getTermApplicableFrom
methods.description: Retrieves the date from which the variation applies.

methods.name: fetchTermApplicaDate
methods.description: Alias for getTermApplicableFrom, retrieves the applicable date.

methods.name: getTermValue
methods.description: Returns the decimal value of the term variation.

methods.name: getDateValue
methods.description: Returns the date value of the variation if applicable.

methods.name: fetchDateValue
methods.description: Alias for getDateValue, returns the date value of the variation.

methods.name: setDateValue
methods.description: Sets the date value for the variation.

methods.name: setTermApplicableFrom
methods.description: Sets the date from which the variation applies.

methods.name: setDecimalValue
methods.description: Sets the decimal value of the variation.

methods.name: getOnLoanStatus
methods.description: Returns the current status of the loan at the time of variation.

methods.name: isActive
methods.description: Checks if the variation is active.

methods.name: parent
methods.description: Retrieves the parent variation, if any.

methods.name: updateIsActive
methods.description: Updates the active status of this variation.
